callouts.text: Radius SEO in the plugin list. This is the installed plugin.
Deactivate opens the keep-or-delete choice. Cancel leaves the plugin on.
Paste the signed license here, then Save. Check does not store the key.
Templates is where you write the blueprint.
Location library is where places are imported.
Deploy publishes a page for each place after the template is ready.
Analytics counts visits and outbound clicks on published landings. The numbers stay on this site.
Add New Template starts a blueprint. One template is usually one service.
Each row is a blueprint. Open it to put tokens in the title and body, then deploy it.
Each landing is one deployed page for one template and one place.
Deploy again to update these pages. It does not add a second copy of the same place.
Service areas are hub pages. Their URLs use the prefix from Settings, General.
Upload a CSV with columns name, lat, and lng. A name column is required.
Leave this off to skip places you already imported. Turn it on to overwrite matches.
Download CSV shows the column order: id, name, slug, country, region, state, zip, lat, lng.
Open Settings, Service areas, and add a center place plus a radius in miles.
After the template is ready, Deploy and update all places writes one current landing per place in range.
Edit template returns to the blueprint if the pages need different wording.
Landing title pattern. Example: Towing in {{place_name}}. Deploy fills the place name.
Import / export holds spintax, template slots, place CSV, and the Magic Page migration. Use migration only when moving an older library.
Each settings job has its own tab. License, General, Service areas, Site replacers, Content and rotation, Database, Integrations.
This prefix is only for hub URLs. Landings stay at the site root.
Lower the deploy batch size when a host times out.
Anchor place is the center of the circle. Pick it from the location library.
Add another circle when you serve more than one region. Save to assign area codes.
A replacer fills a token such as {{company-name}} or {{phone-number}} on every deployed page.
Leave scheduled rotation off unless you want spintax rewritten on a timer.
Database is for leftover Magic Page options. Leave it alone on a new site.
Turn on Elementor only when a template was built in Elementor. Save, then deploy.
Turn on Beaver Builder only when a template was built in Beaver Builder. Save, then deploy.
Open Logs when deploy or import reports a server error. The processing log is the run. The error log is the failure.
Describe what you were trying to do.
Describe what happened. Email support sends this to support@duppinstech.com and does not store a copy.
Help sits at the bottom-right of every Radius screen. It is not a banner at the top.
Open the user guide goes to the guide on duppinstech.com.
Contact support opens Radius, Support, for administrators.
